meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts of facts read from law firms' own public websites and from official open registries on the dates shown, kept for research and marketing planning. Each row's two coverage measures say how much of the market it reaches. The counts describe what websites and registries say, not the quality of any firm or lawyer. A firm can ask us to correct its row or to be left out through the data corrections page; we act within 7 days.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.

records.text: Alaska: 9 law firms found (9 with a website read, 0 from official registries only); coverage: 3% of the 291 employer law offices the Census Bureau counts (County Business Patterns 2023) and about 2% of the estimated 466 law firms with a website; a sample; of the websites read, 11.1% show Spanish-language pages, 22.2% show a 24/7 intake statement, 55.6% show legal structured data, 44.4% show a free consultation statement, 44.4% show a no-fee-unless-we-win or contingency statement, 11.1% show a chat tool, 0.0% show an online booking tool, 33.3% show review markup (schema.org Review or AggregateRating), 66.7% show an llms.txt file.
